newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota lowers domestic sales target for 1997-paper.
newsitem.headline: Toyota lowers domestic sales target for 1997-paper.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp has lowered its domestic sales target for calendar 1997 to 2.15 million vehiles, down 60,000 units from its original goal, business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said at the weekend.
The paper said in its Saturday morning edition that Toyota had made the revision due to unexpectedly sluggish sales after April.
Toyota had informed its dealers of the lower target, although it had publicly said it would not revise the original target, the paper said.
A Toyota spokesman could not immediately confirm the report.
